CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
    CustomerID INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    Segment TEXT NULL,
    Currency TEXT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gasstations (
    GasStationID INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    ChainID INTEGER NULL,
    Country TEXT NULL,
    Segment TEXT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
    ProductID INTEGER UNIQUE NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    Description TEXT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions_1k (
    TransactionID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    Date DATE,
    Time TEXT,
    CustomerID INTEGER,
    CardID INTEGER,
    GasStationID INTEGER,
    ProductID INTEGER,
    Amount INTEGER,
    Price REAL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS yearmonth (
    CustomerID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Date TEXT NOT NULL,
    Consumption REAL,
    PRIMARY KEY (Date, CustomerID),
    FOREIGN KEY (CustomerID) REFERENCES customers (CustomerID)
)
